card.name: Journal names in citations
card.fires_on: The second word of a periodical or journal title in a reference or byline, mainly "American" after "Scientific", and "Med" or "Journal" in citation titles.

modes.label: Scientific American
modes.description: The word "American" right after "Scientific" in magazine names or author bios.
modes.example: Kate Wong is an editor and writer at Scientific<< American>> covering paleontology, archaeology and life

modes.label: Abbreviated journal titles
modes.description: The closing word of a medical journal name in a reference list, such as Med or Journal.
modes.example: Ceaser S, Wurtz R. "Leftover" antibiotics in the medicine cabinet. Ann Intern<< Med>>. 2000;1

card.plain: It lights up on the last word of a magazine or journal name in a reference, like the "American" in Scientific American.
